newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore's Chartered Semiconductor opens in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's Chartered Semiconductor opens in Japan.

text.p: Singapore's Chartered Semiconductor Manufacturing said on Monday it opened an office in Japan as part of its worldwide expansion.
In a statement, it said the office would serve a critical market as Japan is a centre for the manufacture and consumption of integrated circuits.
The company also announced the appointment of Tadao Murayama, vice president of Japan sales, who will oversee the office and be responsible for all sales and customer support.
Chartered Semiconductor is a unit of government-owned Singapore Technologies and is headquarted in Singapore with other offices in the U.S., Europe and Taiwan.
